Code generation is a latency-sensitive task that
demands high timeliness, but the autoregres-
sive decoding mechanism of Large Language
Models (LLMs) leads to poor inference ef-
ficiency.
Existing LLM inference accelera-
tion methods mainly focus on standalone func-
tions using only built-in components. More-
over, they treat code like natural language se-
quences, ignoring its unique syntax and seman-
tic characteristics. As a result, the effective-
ness of these approaches in code generation
tasks remains limited and fails to align with
real-world programming scenarios. To allevi-
ate this issue, we propose CODESWIFT, a sim-
